results.title: For Founders | JustInterview
results.content:
The typical timeline from job post to shortlist is 10 days. Day one covers posting to 40-plus job boards. Days two and three involve AI screening of all applications. Days four through seven include automated first-round AI interviews. By day eight a founder reviews the final shortlist, with offer conversations on days nine and ten. This timeline assumes a standard engineering role with moderate applicant volume.

How much does JustInterview.ai cost for a founder? [...] Yes. JustInterview.ai is designed for founders who need to hire without a dedicated recruiter. The platform posts the job to 40-plus job boards, screens incoming resumes with AI, and conducts first-round on-camera interviews automatically. A founder's total involvement is roughly 3 hours from posting the role to reviewing a ranked shortlist of five candidates — all other steps run without human input.

results.title: About | JustInterview
results.content:
Who is the founder of JustInterview.ai?

JustInterview.ai is led by Rahul Joshi, CEO and founder. Rahul and the founding team built the first version of JIA to fix their own hiring process — coordinating six different tools across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and assessment — before opening it up as a product for other engineering teams.

How is JIA different from a general HR tech company?

JIA wasn't designed top-down as an enterprise HR product. It was built bottom-up by an engineering team that lived the problem daily, which is why it prioritizes running the pipeline automatically over adding another dashboard for recruiters to check. That origin still shapes product decisions today — automation first, manual review only where a human judgment call is actually needed. [...] Chapter02

### What existed wasn't built for us.

We looked at the market. Enterprise tools were built for HR teams of 20, not engineering companies running lean. Lightweight tools only solved one part of the problem. Nothing ran the whole pipeline — sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessing, and selecting — in a single coherent system.

So we did what engineers do when they hit a wall. We built it ourselves.

Chapter03

### We shipped it. Then others asked for it.

We built the first version for our own hiring. It worked well enough that other companies started asking if they could use it. The original internal tool became a product. Two years later, over 2,000 companies run their full hiring pipeline on what started as our fix to a problem we lived every week. [...] JustInterview.ai
